description: This file defines a DynamoDb_Memory class implementing in-memory chat memory using DynamoDB, including methods for initialization, adding, retrieving, and clearing messages, with integration to AWS SDK and langchain utilities.

classes.name: DynamoDb_Memory
classes.description: Implements a DynamoDB-backed chat memory node with methods for managing chat history.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends FlowiseMemory to handle DynamoDB operations for chat message storage and retrieval.

methods.name: initializeDynamoDB
methods.description: Initializes DynamoDB client and memory object based on node data and options.

methods.name: overrideDynamoKey
methods.description: Overrides the DynamoDB key with a new session ID if provided.

methods.name: addNewMessage
methods.description: Adds new messages to DynamoDB, appending to existing message list.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from DynamoDB, optionally converting to base messages and prepending messages.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Adds user and API messages to DynamoDB chat history.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Deletes chat messages from DynamoDB for a session.
